resources.string: Time for a quick check-in. How is your day going?
A small next step for your day. Guidance is optional; your tasks and deadlines stay under your control.
Online guidance sends this check-in and the task/habit details you enable to Google Gemini. Use Coach settings to choose what to share. No request runs automatically in the background.
Your first check-in will appear here.
Next reminder postponed within your waking hours.
Allow sending my check-ins to Google Gemini
Include today’s tasks, project priorities and recent project task history
Include up to 20 current habits and today’s completion

Your key and coach history stay in app-private storage and are excluded from Android backups and journal exports. They are not encrypted by this feature. Anyone with access to a compromised device may retrieve them. Reminders run approximately every four hours, from morning to evening.
Delete all check-ins, guidance and coach focus plans? Your journal tasks, habits and API key will not change.
API key removed. Offline coaching is still available.
Enter a model ID and a start hour earlier than the evening hour (0–23). Use only letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores in the model ID.
The key contains embedded whitespace or unsupported characters. Copy the key itself, not its label or surrounding text.
Enter your personal API key first.
Enter available time between 0 and 960 minutes.
Working… Your check-in stays saved if the connection fails.
Coach is already working. Please try again in a moment.
Offline guidance saved. No information was sent to Google.
Offline guidance shown because permission to send check-ins to Gemini is off. Enable it in Coach Settings to receive online suggestions.
Offline guidance shown because no Gemini API key is saved. Add one in Coach Settings to receive online suggestions.
You do not have to solve the whole day at once. A small step or a deliberate rest can be enough for now.
Choose one manageable action. If you have the energy, give it five minutes; otherwise pause and reassess.
You have no time available right now. Leave the task list as it is and check in when you have room to breathe.
After that, check your energy before deciding what comes next.
Could not save this check-in. Please try again.
The connection failed or timed out. Your check-in is saved with offline guidance. You can retry.
This device is connected to Wi‑Fi, but Android has not confirmed internet access. Reconnect Wi‑Fi or wait for the connection to recover, then retry.
Gemini rejected the request. Check the saved API key, access and model settings. Your check-in is safe.
This model is unavailable. Check the model ID in Coach settings.
Gemini’s usage limit was reached. Your check-in is saved. Retry later.
Secure networking could not start on this device. Offline coaching is available.
Gemini returned an incomplete or invalid plan. Nothing was applied; offline guidance is available.
Secure connection and structured response verified. No journal data was sent.
Focus plan saved. Journal tasks and deadlines were not changed.
This plan has already been used. Submit another check-in for an updated plan.
This suggestion is out of date or its tasks changed. Get fresh guidance before using it.
Replace today’s displayed coach focus plan with this suggestion? This does not edit tasks, deadlines, habits or points. You can undo this change.
Reminders are off. You can check in whenever you like.
Reminders are on: morning, roughly every four hours, and evening.
Notifications are blocked by Android. Enable them in the system app settings to receive reminders.
Save your API key and enable online sharing in Coach settings first. You can still check in offline.
